name: Hazim
bio:
Hazimism, also referred to as the Hazimi movement or known as the Hazimiyyah or Hazimi current, is a movement within the ideology of Islamic State. The movement was derived from the doctrines of the Saudi-born Muslim scholar Ahmad ibn Umar al-Hazimi, which was adopted by many Tunisian recruits within ISIS.
